name: Niçoise-Style Tuna Salad with French Dressed Greens & Goat Cheese
ingredients: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water
instructions: Drain tuna, place in a medium bowl, and flake with a fork.
Roughly chop eggs and add to the bowl with the tuna.
Mince olives and capers; add to the bowl.
Add pesto and mayo to the bowl; stir to combine the tuna mixture and set aside.
Place broccoli slaw in a large bowl.
Wash and dry lettuce; chop or tear into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the broccoli slaw.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl; add pine nuts and vinaigrette. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates and top with tuna mixture. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
